full_prompt_en: A square comic illustration in ink, gray wash, and restrained red paint shows a formal man from the waist upward against a mostly bare ivory background. The camera looks slightly upward, so his shoulders are broad and his chin lifts above the viewer. He stands near the center, facing forward but turning his head a little toward the right. Sleek black hair sweeps back from his forehead, and large round goggles with rust-red lenses hide his eyes. The rims are dark and heavy, making the two warm circles the highest point of color in the image. His pale face is angular, with a straight nose, closed mouth, and hard gray shadow beneath the cheekbones and jaw. A high white shirt collar frames the neck, topped by a small dark-red bow tie. Under a loose charcoal black jacket he wears a vivid scarlet waistcoat with visible buttons and broken dark creases. The jacket shoulders and lapels are rendered with broad expressive gray-black brush strokes; they fade into quick unfinished marks at the lower edges. Thin pencil-like construction lines remain around the figure and across the blank background. A muted pink rectangular shadow sits behind the left side of his head, and a few faint vertical architectural lines rise through the left background without resolving into a complete setting. The right side remains mostly open white, emphasizing the silhouette. Light comes from high left, leaving bright highlights on the face, collar, and goggles while placing dense slate shadows under the jaw and across the suit. Red is used sparingly but decisively: lenses, bow tie, and vest hold attention against black, gray, and exposed paper. The image combines polished facial rendering with sketchy, visibly unfinished edges, forming a poised, theatrical character study in a wide field of negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形漫画插画以墨线、灰色水洗和克制的红色颜料描绘一名正装男子，从腰部以上出现在几乎空白的象牙白背景前。视点略向上看，使他的肩膀宽阔，下巴扬在观者上方。他站在中心附近，身体正对前方，头稍向右转。光滑黑发从额前向后梳去，巨大的圆形护目镜以锈红镜片遮住双眼。镜框暗而厚重，让两枚暖色圆形成为画面最高处的色彩重点。他的浅色脸庞棱角鲜明，鼻梁直、嘴闭合，颧骨与下颌下有坚硬灰影。竖起的白衬衫领框住脖子，上面系着小小深红领结。在松散的炭黑外套下，他穿一件亮猩红马甲，纽扣可见，表面有断续暗褶。外套肩部与翻领由宽阔、有表现力的灰黑笔触描出，在下部边缘化为快速且未完成的笔迹。细铅笔般构建线留在人物四周及空白背景上。一块暗粉矩形阴影位于头部左后方，几条淡淡竖向建筑线穿过左背景，却未形成完整场景。右侧大部保持空白白色，突出剪影。光从左上来，在脸、衣领与镜片上留下亮处，在下颌与西装上压出浓密石板灰影。红色用得少而果断：镜片、领结和马甲在黑、灰与露出纸色之间抓住视线。画面将精细的面部塑造与可见的草绘未完成边缘结合，在宽敞留白中形成沉着又戏剧化的人物形象。
style_prompt_en: Illustrative ink and wash combines precise dark contours at the focal area with broad, rough gray brush planes that break apart toward the margins. A small set of saturated scarlet and rust-red accents punctuates a mostly ivory, charcoal, and slate-gray field. Clear geometry and shaded volume concentrate near the center, while light pencil construction traces and unfinished strokes remain visible in the surrounding open ground. Hard shadow shapes sharpen selected planes, yet dry edges and diluted washes let other contours breathe. Lighting is directional, giving pale exposed areas strong relief against cool dark masses. The composition relies on a tall compact silhouette and expansive negative space, with crisp detail near the visual center and increasing looseness outward.
style_prompt_zh: 墨线与水洗式插画让焦点区域有准确的深色轮廓，宽阔粗犷的灰色笔面则朝边缘逐渐断开。少量饱和猩红与锈红点缀在以象牙白、炭黑和石板灰为主的色域里。清楚几何与明暗体积集中在中心，浅铅笔构建痕与未完成笔迹仍留在周围开阔底色中。硬影形状加强选定平面，干笔边与稀释水洗又让别处轮廓有呼吸余地。光有明确方向，使露出的浅色区域在冷暗色块前获得强烈浮凸。构图依靠高而紧凑的剪影及宽阔负空间，视觉中心附近细节清晰，向外越来越松散。
theme_en: A formal man in red goggles and a scarlet waistcoat
theme_zh: 一名戴红色护目镜、穿猩红马甲的正装男子
name: Olivier Coipel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
